about_the_game:
"Knight Nier" is a strategy game that combines card rogue and role - playing elements. Travel to a different world, becoming a knight employed by a magic lord, a mercenary fighting for money, or a ronin who acts at will. Encounter the heroes of the magic kingdom, discover the true crisis of the world through choices, and embark on an adventure to uncover the truth of the world.

Pick up your sword, meet companions on the journey, search for relics, pick up new cards, and fight monsters and enemies.

There is a proud magic lord; And a brave and resolute barbarian princess; a silent knight who is taciturn and bent on revenge;

But beneath the peaceful calm, the foreign undead are brewing a catastrophic disaster.

Will the knights unite the heroes and use the power of the entire world to fight against the foreign enemies, or collect magic weapons and reverse the situation with their own strength to become lone heroes; or even turn to the dark side for power, using the enemy's spear to attack their shield.

Game features:

Combining rouge cards with role - playing, choosing different plot branches, collecting cards and magic weapons, constantly strengthening the protagonist's power, and deriving different plot branches according to the players' different choices. Get prepared for the ultimate battle.
